description: Change of use (temporary 3 years) of existing car park area (Class F1/F2(c), previously Class D1/D2) to Sui Generis to allow the sale of cars.
decision_conditions: The commercial car sales use and all associated temporary structures and fixtures, including the car cleaning facility, hereby permitted shall be discontinued on or before three years from the date of this planning permission. Upon cessation of the use, all temporary structures, fixtures and fittings associated with the car sales use shall be removed and the land restored to its previous lawful use and condition.
REASON:

The use is considered acceptable only on a temporary basis having regard to the circumstances of the site and to enable the Local Planning Authority to review the use in light of the future use of the wider site and the planning policy circumstances prevailing at that time, in accordance with Policy DMEI 4 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 (2020), Policy G2 of the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2026).
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans, numbers
REASON
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020), and the London Plan (2021).

The commercial car sales/storage use hereby permitted shall operate only within the area identified for car sales/storage on approved drawing 233-L(20)-200 Rev P5. No vehicles associated with the commercial car sales use shall be displayed, stored or parked on adjoining areas of the wider Country Club site outside the approved area.
REASON:

To ensure that the commercial use remains confined to the existing developed car park, to protect the openness and purposes of the Green Belt and to ensure sufficient land remains available to serve the lawful F1/F2(c) use of the wider site.
4. Operating Hours
The commercial car sales use shall not operate outside the following hours:
10:00 to 19:00 Mondays to Saturdays; and
11:00 to 16:00 Sundays, Public Holidays and Bank Holidays.
REASON:
To safeguard the residential amenities of adjoining and nearby occupiers in accordance with Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).

A minimum of three birch trees, or such alternative species as may first be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, shall be planted in accordance with the approved landscaping details during the first available planting season following the date of this permission.

Any tree which dies, is removed or becomes seriously damaged or diseased within five years of planting shall be replaced during the next available planting season with a tree of a similar size and species unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
REASON:

To secure appropriate air quality mitigation and contribute towards the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Policies DMEI 14 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 (2020) and Policy SI1 of the London Plan (2021).

On this decision notice policies from the Councils Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies appear first, then relevant Local Plan Part 2 (2020), then London Plan Policies (2016). Hillingdon's Full Council adopted the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies on 8 November 2012 and the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 on 16 January 2020.
subdivision_of_building: Car park and single-storey building by the access only.
